newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines says needs to import 300,000T of corn.
newsitem.headline: Philippines says needs to import 300,000T of corn.

text.p: The Philippines is planning to import at least 300,000 tonnes of corn before July this year, Agriculture Undersecretary Joemarie Gerochi said on Thursday.
Gerochi said a Cabinet-level committee had endorsed a proposal to import corn for animal feeds to President Fidel Ramos.
Philippine hog raisers had asked government to import corn at lower tariffs to cover for the domestic corn shortage.
State-controlled National Food Authority had so far imported 120,000 tonnes of yellow corn from China and 25,000 tonnes of U.S. white corn since the start of the year.
